cases.entryRequirement: Workspace API in real temporary project; controlled subprocess/OS boundary where needed
cases.boundary: Content-based recovery and separate subsequent current Push decision

expected.allowed: Only existing recovered-data bookkeeping/abandonment transitions; retain original basis and binding.
expected.media: No asset copy/backup/write; media does not choose the recovery branch or manufacture pending.

checkReadonly.freshness: Preserve initial/fresh/stale basis; Check cannot publish or refresh it. Exclude only the explicitly recorded external test-driver mutation when comparing trees.

compileGateError.basis: Do not publish this candidate or upgrade an earlier output. Preserve existing prepublication failure semantics.

compileSuccess.basis: Only successful Compile establishes the current compilation basis; live asset facts are absent from it.

compilePublicationFailure.boundary: Publication has started; fault before successful Manifest completion.
compilePublicationFailure.basis: Retain existing invalid-output semantics; do not promise the old output survives. No successful/fresh new output claim; successful recompile is required.

pushAssetBeforeWriteError.pending: Do not create this Push's pending state.
pushAssetBeforeWriteError.staging: Clean staged files according to existing rules.

pushSuccess.projectData: Only Affected Project Data Files change to generated bytes.
pushSuccess.snapshotAndManifest: Complete normal synchronization bookkeeping using the verified compilation basis.
pushSuccess.pending: Clear completed pending; do not retain it for asset-only changes.
pushSuccess.assets: No copies/backups/tool writes; only explicit external mutation is allowed.

pushNoWriteError.pending: No new pending for an asset error.
pushNoWriteError.snapshotAndManifest: Do not manufacture successful new synchronization state.

pushInputPrewriteStop.projectData: Do not start replacing data under changed source/dependency/config/Snapshot/generated/binding.
pushInputPrewriteStop.authority: Do not adopt changed inputs or grant a new target/policy authority mid-command.
pushInputPrewriteStop.pending: The explicit no-new-pending guarantee is specified for asset-only gate errors. This plan does not invent a stronger pending guarantee for all existing input-protection failure boundaries.

pushInputPostwriteFailure.projectData: Acknowledge already written generated bytes; no rollback or 'nothing written' claim.
pushInputPostwriteFailure.snapshotAndManifest: Do not complete ordinary synchronization under inconsistent inputs/data evidence.
pushInputPostwriteFailure.pending: Retain Interrupted Push with its original binding and compilation evidence.
pushInputPostwriteFailure.assets: No postwrite asset scan; no asset copying or backup.

recoveryAllGenerated.recoveryOutcome: Complete verified data bookkeeping even if media are missing.
recoveryAllGenerated.pending: Clear the recovered pending before ordinary current Push prerequisites/gate; a later current failure must not recreate pending for completed data.
recoveryAllGenerated.basis: Preserve original structure/hash/version/binding; do not upgrade it.
recoveryAllGenerated.projectData: Do not acquire new write authority through recovery.

recoveryAllSnapshot.recoveryOutcome: Abandon the all-old interrupted attempt according to existing content evidence.
recoveryAllSnapshot.pending: Remove abandoned pending, then run normal current Push validation.
recoveryAllSnapshot.basis: Retain original evidence semantics; no recovery-derived new authority.

recoveryRefused.recoveryOutcome: Refuse automatic recovery for mixed/missing/unknown/inconsistent evidence.
recoveryRefused.pending: Retain evidence for explicit recovery; no automatic repair.
recoveryRefused.projectData: No automatic overwrite/rollback to force a uniform state.
recoveryRefused.assets: Availability cannot substitute for data evidence.

forbiddenToolActions: media hashing/content reads for this existence gate
allAssetsReadonly.necessaryExternalFields: Read only; preserve original names and unknown fields.

invariantContracts.roots: Current generated/candidate Map/Common/Troop events only; Common Events are independent roots; preserve finite direct117/Skill-effect edges without copying defining uses or enumerating transitive caller paths.
invariantContracts.capturedData: Selected external standard fields use the same captured Snapshot. Unpulled live data is drift, not a supplemental dependency source.

gates.check: One asset pass after trusted output validation, before returning.
gates.compile: One asset pass before local publication; none at Manifest commit.
gates.writingPush: After staging and passed prerequisites, before creating pending or first project replacement.
gates.noWritePush: After ordinary prerequisites, before return, even without differences.
gates.postwrite: No further media scan; asset-only changes allow normal data bookkeeping.

invariantContracts.protectedInputs: Source, validation dependencies, relevant config/exceptions, Snapshot, generated bytes and binding retain existing before-write/completion protection; full standard-data drift and per-file old-content guards remain.
invariantContracts.persistence: No live file observations in Compile Baseline/Generated Freshness; policy and Compile Contract Version remain compilation inputs.
invariantContracts.recovery: Original binding/understood content evidence decide all-generated/all-snapshot/refusal; current assets cannot block completed-data bookkeeping or re-pend it. Current freshness/drift/asset gate are subsequent decisions.
invariantContracts.retired: No cross-point media-observation comparator, improvement failure, postwrite media scan, cycle diagnostic or transitive caller-path use multiplication.
